001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.content.Intent;
004import android.os.Bundle;
005import android.view.LayoutInflater;
006import android.view.View;
007import android.view.ViewGroup;
008import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
009import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
010import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult;
011import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
012import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
013import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
014import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
015import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider;
016import androidx.navigation.Navigation;
017import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInAccount;
018import com.google.android.material.snackbar.Snackbar;
019import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.LoginViewModel;
020import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
021import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.FragmentLoginBinding;
022
023/**
024 * A fragment that handles the login functionality in the application using Google Sign-In.
025 *
026 *
027 * This fragment integrates with a LoginViewModel to manage the sign-in state and handle related
028 * operations, such as initiating a sign-in flow, processing results, and observing changes to the user's sign-in status or errors.
029 *
030 * Key behaviors of this fragment include:
031 * - Setting up and binding to a view using data binding.
032 * - Observing LiveData from the LoginViewModel to handle account state and error handling.
033 * - Registering and managing an ActivityResultLauncher for sign-in result handling.
034 * - Navigating to the home fragment upon successful sign-in.
035 * - Displaying error messages through a Snackbar when sign-in fails.
036 *
037 * Methods:
038 * - onCreateView: Inflates the layout and sets up a click listener for the sign-in button to initiate the sign-in process.
039 * - onViewCreated: Initializes the LoginViewModel, observes relevant LiveData for account and error state changes, and registers the ActivityResultLauncher.
040 * - onDestroyView: Cleans up resources when the view is destroyed.
041 * - handleAccount: Handles the successful sign-in by navigating to the home fragment.
042 * - handleThrowable: Handles sign-in errors by showing a Snackbar with an appropriate message.
043 */
044public class LoginFragment extends Fragment {
045
046  private FragmentLoginBinding binding;
047  private LoginViewModel viewModel;
048  private ActivityResultLauncher<Intent> launcher;
049
050  @Nullable
051  @Override
052  public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container,
053      @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
054    binding = FragmentLoginBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
055    binding.signIn.setOnClickListener((v) -> viewModel.startSignIn(launcher));
056    return binding.getRoot();
057  }
058
059  @Override
060  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
061    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
062    viewModel = new ViewModelProvider(requireActivity())
063        .get(LoginViewModel.class);
064    LifecycleOwner owner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
065    viewModel
066        .getAccount()
067        .observe(owner, this::handleAccount);
068    viewModel
069        .getSignInThrowable()
070        .observe(owner, this::handleThrowable);
071    launcher = registerForActivityResult(new StartActivityForResult(), viewModel::completeSignIn);
072  }
073
074  @Override
075  public void onDestroyView() {
076    super.onDestroyView();
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Handles the successful sign-in by navigating to the home fragment.
081   *
082   * @param account the GoogleSignInAccount object obtained after a successful sign-in.
083   *                If null, no action is performed.
084   */
085  private void handleAccount(GoogleSignInAccount account) {
086    if (account != null) {
087      Navigation.findNavController(binding.getRoot())
088          .navigate(LoginFragmentDirections.navigateToHomeFragment());
089    }
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * Handles throwable errors by displaying a user-facing message.
094   *
095   * @param throwable the throwable object representing the error. If null, no action is performed.
096   */
097  private void handleThrowable(Throwable throwable) {
098    if (throwable != null) {
099      Snackbar.make(binding.getRoot(), R.string.sign_in_failure_message, Snackbar.LENGTH_LONG)
100          .show();
101    }
102  }
103}
